image_description: A high-angle outdoor shot featuring a wooden deck staircase with black metal railings. The foreground shows a thick, light-colored wooden handrail and vertical black metal balusters. The stairs descend to the right, leading towards a driveway where two pickup trucks are parked on gravel. Green grass and trees fill the background.
